NORAD ID: 39216

Launch date: July 25, 2013
Source: India (IND)
Launch site: FRENCH GUIANA (FRGUI)

INSAT 3D is an indian meteorological satellite launched aboard the Ariane 5 ECA weighting 2,120 kilograms at launch and is designed to operate for seven years from 82 degrees east in geostationary orbit. The satellite carries a six-channel imager and a 19-channel sounder instrument, with the latter designed to take vertical profiles of atmospheric humidity, temperature and ozone levels. Insat 3D also carries a search-and-rescue transponder to relay distress signals from maritime, aeronautical and terrestrial beacons to alert rescue centers.
